'''Riley''' (Japanese: '''リュウジ''' ''Ryūji'') is [[Wanda]]'s husband in [[Pokémon Adventures]].

He first appears in ''[[PS218|It's Absol-lutely a Bad Omen]]'', as the head of the construction crew in the [[Rusturf Tunnel]], when it unexpectedly collapses on him due to earthquakes. {{adv|Ruby}} rescues him.

He and Wanda are later married during the {{MangaArc|Emerald}}.

==In the games==
Riley is based on Wanda's nameless boyfriend from {{game2|Ruby|Sapphire|Emerald}}, trapped on the west side of the [[breakable rock]]s in the Rusturf Tunnel.

He will give {{HM|04|Strength}}{{sup/3|RSE}} or the [[Aggronite]]{{sup/6|ORAS}} if the player helps clear the rocks.

==Trivia==
* The {{MangaArc|Emerald}} showcases two different characters with the same English name, as [[Riley]] of [[Sinnoh]] makes a cameo at the end of the chapter.
